name: Polar Preview
description: The polar response of a scattering result (ISO 17497-2, 3.8): the level reflected from the sample into every receiver direction, for one incidence direction and one octave band, as a balloon mesh coloured by level. A direction at 0 dB (the level of the flat reference's specular reflection) is at radius from the centre, a direction at floor_db or below at the centre; blue is the lowest level, red the highest. The source output is a line towards the incidence direction. The Preview button shows or hides the drawing.

inputParameters.name: preview
inputParameters.description: Which incidence direction: an index of the result's preview sources, labelled with their colatitude (theta) and azimuth (phi) in degrees.

inputParameters.name: octave
inputParameters.description: The octave band in Hz, one the result simulated.

inputParameters.name: body
inputParameters.description: 'sample' or 'reference' (the flat reference of the same size).

inputParameters.name: radius
inputParameters.description: The radius of a direction at 0 dB, in model units.

inputParameters.name: floor_db
inputParameters.description: A negative level in dB: a direction at this level or below is at the centre.

inputParameters.name: centre
inputParameters.description: Optional. The point the balloon is centred on; the origin unless given.

outputParameters.name: mesh
outputParameters.description: The balloon, each face in the colour of the mean level of its vertices.

outputParameters.name: levels
outputParameters.description: The level in dB of each receiver direction (each vertex of the mesh before it is split into faces).

outputParameters.name: source
outputParameters.description: A line from the centre towards the incidence direction.
